task_objective: Reconstruct current project state, blocker boundary and next safe action from durable workflow and evidence artifacts.

text_first_baseline.input_summary: Broad text bundle from chat summaries, workflow notes, status notes and task history.

gates: last completed batch must be identified
next safe action must match durable state
stale or chat-only context must not override workflow state

expected.transition_boundary: handoff reconstruction may set next action but may not skip required gates or claim completed work without evidence
expected.evidence_boundary: handoff output may summarize durable state and next action; it may not treat chat memory as stronger than workflow evidence

limitations: Fixture is public-safe and abstracts the concrete project handoff.
Execution scoring is stored separately in the execution record.
Reviewer scoring is non-independent until an external or separated reviewer is added.
